summary: Ticket list is a support queue where the agent has already triaged each ticket and drafted a reply. Rows show a priority dot, the customer, how long they have waited and who the ticket is assigned to. Opening a ticket shows the customer's message and the suggested reply, which a person can edit before choosing Send and solve.
use: When an agent triages incoming support tickets and drafts answers for a person to approve
When a support lead wants urgent tickets to stand out by colour
When replies should be edited in place before they go out
When solved tickets should leave the open queue but stay one click away
features: A coloured dot marks `priority`: urgent red, high amber, normal accent and low grey, with the name in a tooltip.
While shut, each row shows the customer and a preview of their `question`, plus the `waiting` time and assignee avatar.
Opening a row shows the question and the agent's `reply` in an editable box; Edit puts the cursor at the end of it.
Send and solve calls `onSend` with the ticket and the reply as edited; a promise shows a spinner, then the row fades out, folds its height away so the rows under it slide up, and moves to Solved.
An Open and Solved switch filters the list, and an empty filter shows `emptyLabel`, "All caught up" by default.
`tickets`, `filter` and `open` can each be controlled or left to the component.
a11y: Each ticket row is a button with `aria-expanded` reporting whether it is open.
The Send and solve button sets `aria-busy` while sending.
The Open and Solved switch is a `group` labelled Filter, with `aria-pressed` on each option.

faq.q: Does the reply that gets sent include the person's edits?
faq.a: Yes. `onSend` receives the text currently in the reply box, edited or not. That text is also saved on the ticket when it moves to Solved.
If the promise from `onSend` rejects, the spinner stops and the ticket stays open, so the person can try again.

faq.q: How do I open the most urgent ticket for the person?
faq.a: Control `open` with `onOpenChange` and set it to that ticket's id. The example opens the urgent ticket a second after it loads.
